scripts.serve: sh -c 'docker info >/dev/null 2>&1 || open -gj -a Docker; echo "Waiting for Docker Desktop..."; i=0; until docker info >/dev/null 2>&1; do i=$((i + 1)); if [ "$i" -ge 60 ]; then echo "Docker Desktop startup timed out" >&2; exit 1; fi; sleep 2; done; if [ ! -f .env ]; then cp .env.example .env; fi; docker compose stop web >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml up -d postgres cubestore_router cubestore_worker cube_refresh_worker cube'
